Q. 1 رَأْبَلَ . inf. n. رَأْبَلَةٌ, He was, or became, wicked, crafty, or cunning; as also ↓ تَرَأْبَلَ . (T in art. ربل.) ＝
-A2- رَأْبَلَةٌ (M, K) inf. n. of رَأْبَلَ, said of a man; (T, K;) [also signifies] The walking (M, K) of a man (M) inclining (M, K) to either side, (M,) or to one side, (K,) as though having the feet attenuated, and chafed, or abraded. (M, K. [يَتَوَخَّى in the CK is a mistake for يَتَوَجَّى, which is expressly said in the TA to be with جيم.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
